This small piece of land near my home is my main maize plot, and I depend on it to feed my family. I try every year to get the FISP coupon so I can buy the subsidized fertilizer and a small packet of hybrid seed — last season I managed to get one, so I am hoping again. I will plant together with pigeon pea between the maize ridges as we always do here in Machinga. I cannot afford to hire much labor for such a small plot — my wife and older children will help me weed, and maybe I will pay one or two people for a day during the busy weeding time.
